description: Run `groundwork init [archetype]` in a repo: writes the adapter boundary, redaction config, gold-set templates, GitHub Action, and playbook for a deployment pattern — document-qa (documents → grounded answers) or extraction (documents → structured fields). Never overwrites existing files. After scaffolding, the human wires groundwork/adapter.mjs and replaces the example gold cases with real ones.
